```{r}
library(ggplot2)
source("lib_swc.R")
options(timeout=120)
```


# Load some morphologies
```{r}
swcs <- list(
  read_swc("https://download.brainimagelibrary.org/3a/88/3a88a7687ab66069/excitatory/20171204_sample_2.SWC"),
  read_swc("https://download.brainimagelibrary.org/3a/88/3a88a7687ab66069/excitatory/20171204_sample_4.SWC"),
  read_swc("https://download.brainimagelibrary.org/3a/88/3a88a7687ab66069/excitatory/20171204_sample_5.SWC")
)
```

# Compute density of 3 SWC, and display
```{r}
dens <- lapply(swcs,swc_density)
for(d in dens) {
  image(d,asp=1)  
}
# also display average
image(Reduce(function(a,b){a$z <- a$z + b$z;a},dens),asp=1)
```


```{r}
swcs[[2]] |>
  within({p <- match(parent_id,sample_id);parent.x <- x[p];parent.y <- y[p];parent.z <- z[p]}) |>
  ggplot() + 
    geom_segment(aes(x=x,y=z,xend=parent.x,yend=parent.z,color=structure_label)) + 
    coord_equal() + xlab("") + ylab("depth") +
    theme_classic()
```
